The '''''Marauder''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that carried some [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] pirates during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were captured by the crew of the ''Marauder'' and taken aboard the ship, where they were forced to participate in a gladiatorial fight. However, during the fight, the ''Marauder'' was destroyed by the forces of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who ordered his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to use the pirate ship for target practice. This vessel may have been associated with [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]].
